ops.text: Veldhuis et al. (2026) describe this growth by a bit-growth law, under which the precision a recurrent state needs to stay close to its FP32 trajectory increases by about 0.62 bits per entry for every doubling of the context.

new_bib.text: J. Veldhuis, F. Postma, R. Zwart, and M. Dekkers (2026). How many bits does a recurrent state need? Context-length scaling of state precision in Mamba and gated linear attention. arXiv preprint.
